tool_args.rationale: The open-branch probe widens the gradient range, allowing sink strength to be estimated rather than fixed to the source-derived range. Fit the source-guided saturating sink model with a simple relay branch over the full fallback bounds, then use fresh confirmation to test it.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Deferred because the source mechanism specifies a branch term and the pilot has small systematic deviations from the base curve.
The acquired wide-gradient observation and source evidence call for a sink-dependent model.
The open-branch observation has supplied the missing gradient leverage; a trajectory batch is not yet justified.
It does not resolve the identified mechanism ambiguity.
